title: CarrierFormat
description: Versioned, immutable carrier format spec replayed deterministically by LossRun.Formats (brief 05). Design: docs/architecture/carrier-format-memory.md KQ2 (CarrierFormat record), KQ1 (two-tier fingerprint), KQ4 (routing), KQ7 (drift/versioning). Published once as formats/{formatId}/{version}.json; a change is a new version. Per-field success counters live in the mutable sidecar formats/{formatId}/stats.json, not here.

specSchema.description: 0.5.0 replaces claimStatusRule with statusFrom and adds absentComponents (brief 19 Answers 1-2). 0.2.0 adds `learning`; 0.3.0 adds `tableLocator.rowShape`, `periods.kind` and `periods.noLossesPattern` (ADR 0016, ADR 0017); 0.4.0 adds `tableLocator.records`, column-map `line` / `under` / `part` / `partPattern` / `components`, `claimStatusRule` and the `labelNext` locator (ADR 0018). Older specs remain valid.

formatId.description: Stable id of the format family (carrier + layout).

carrierNames.description: Brief 35: the carrier's other legal names (one carrier group prints several), added by a reviewer who answered "same carrier" in a review (formatChanges carrierNames.add); never written by the learn model. Carrier names compare without corporate words (Inc, Co, Insurance, Indemnity, Casualty, Mutual, Group, of America, The).

status.description: Status at publication (null = active). Live status is in the stats sidecar (lifecycle per version): shadow → active after 3 clean replays or underwriter approval; drift/delta versions inherit (06 review, Answers 4).

learning.description: How a learned spec was produced (brief 06); null for hand-written specs.

verificationGate.description: Gate that admitted the spec (ADR 0007 as amended in the 06 review).

learnedFrom.description: Rendering of the exemplar the version was learned from (08b Answers 5): native, spreadsheet, scan-<dpi rounded to 50> or scan (resolution unknown). Low-resolution scans (< 280 dpi) are never learned from.

model.description: Embedding deployment the centroid was built with (configuration value).

blockAnchor.description: Regex over paragraphs opening a policy-period block (groups policyNumber, effectiveDate, expirationDate).

rowShape.description: claims (default): each data row is a claim. periodSummary (ADR 0017): each data row is one period of a summary-only run; money columns (claim.* or period.subtotals.*) and count columns (period.subtotals.claimCount|openCount|closedCount) fill that period's subtotals, period.* columns its label and dates.

records.description: ADR 0018: a claim record printed on more than one line. rows: a row with a value under keySource opens a record and the rows after it without one are its lines 1, 2, ... (column-map entries with line and under). lines: each claim row owns the loose lines printed after it, outside the claim table (lineFields read them); a loose line a subtotal/grandTotal row kind matches is a total row, amounts assigned to columns by position. A record ends at the next key row or claim row, a total row, or maxLines. measures: each claim (or total) prints one row per measure, labelled in a cell ('Inc:', 'Pd:', 'O/S:'), under component columns ('Total | Claim | Medical | Expense'); a key row or a total row opens the record and the labelled rows after it are its measures. Map each component column to the component without a measure (claim.indemnity, claim.medical, claim.expense, claim.total); replay reads it on every measure row. In this mode a column headed 'Claim' or 'Loss' beside Medical and Expense is the indemnity component.

keySource.description: rows: the printed header whose non-empty cell opens a record (default: the claim number column).

measureLabels.description: measures: .NET regexes over a whole cell naming each measure row; null uses the defaults (Pd / Paid, O/S / Outstanding / Reserve, Inc / Incurred, with an optional colon).

pattern.description: .NET regex over a loose line, then over each part of it (values printed apart on one line, split at gaps wider than two word heights); group value is the value, else the whole match. Write the shape of the value (letters, digit runs, separators), never one printed value.

offset.description: 0-based loose line after the claim row (negative from the record's last line); null: the first line the pattern matches.

source.description: Printed header (composed form for stacked headers).

line.description: ADR 0018 records: the record line the value is printed on (0 = the key line).

under.description: ADR 0018 records: for line >= 1, the line-0 header the value is printed under.

part.description: ADR 0018: position of the value in a stacked cell (a header 'Claim Number' over 'Claim Type': two entries with the same source, part 0 and 1). Lineage records the cell once with the part.

partPattern.description: Regex with groups p0, p1, ... for a stacked cell printed on one line; default: the cell's printed lines.

components.description: ADR 0018: for a claim.total.* column whose header names its components ('Paid CLM + MED + EXP', 'Total Incurred (Ind+Med)'); indemnity + medical sets document.totalComposition so R-29 (not R-20) checks the sum.

fillDown.description: source column only (brief 30 item 20): the policy number is printed on the first row of a group only, so a blank policy cell means the period above. False: such a row is attached there as an issue for review. The learn lint sets it when the learning document shows the pattern: two or more blank policy cells, each under a printed policy, never a period's first row, the policy never repeated on the next row (brief 31).

noLossesPattern.description: Regex for the carrier's per-period 'no losses' statement (ADR 0016); null uses the default. A matching row without an amount marks its period and is not a claim.

effectiveHeader.description: Summary column holding the period effective date, when it is not printed as a range in one cell.

expirationHeader.description: Summary column holding the period expiration date (with effectiveHeader).

target.description: document.* fields; period.policyNumber / effectiveDate / expirationDate only with a headerLabel locator, for a single-period run whose header block prints them (brief 23). One label is one field: never read two targets from the same label (only a policy period range may give both dates), and read document.carrierName from the carrier's own label (Carrier, Insurer), never from the insured's (brief 35).

type.description: headerLabel (brief 23): label is the printed label of a header-block field ('Valued as of', 'Insured', 'Policy Period'); replay reads the value printed after it on its line, by the field's kind (a date, a name, a policy number, a date window).

pattern.description: regex / regexPresent: .NET regex over each paragraph, then over each printed line rebuilt from the OCR words (its parts first); on a spreadsheet, over each cell's text. Group value is the value, else the whole match. Prompt markup (a markdown '#', a paragraph role such as 'pageFooter:') is not printed text. A label and its value in two cells is labelRight, not a regex.

reason.description: Required in review for const locators: why the value is declared rather than read.

statusFrom.description: Brief 19 Answers 2, per format: the run prints no status. closeDate: closed when a close date is printed, open otherwise (kept only when verified against printed open/closed counts). unknown: status unknown on every claim, flagged by R-30.

absentComponents.description: Brief 19 Answers 1: components the run prints no column for. The canonical document records { present: false }; the learn gate does not require them.
